description: Create the complete admin dashboard with all 6 PHP files in /admin/ directory: index.php (dashboard with day summary, stats, weekly chart), alumnos.php (CRUD for students), tutores.php (CRUD for tutors), asistencias.php (attendance history with filters/pagination), usuarios.php (system users CRUD), dispositivos.php (FCM tokens viewer with test notification). Each file includes: sidebar navigation, auth check, header with user info, responsive design matching project color scheme.
steps: Create admin/index.php - Dashboard principal with: session auth check (redirect to ../login_admin.php), require_once '../conexion.php', sidebar navigation with all 6 sections, header with user name and logout button, stat cards (total entradas/salidas hoy, alumnos en plantel vs fuera), ultimos movimientos table (last 10 real-time), weekly attendance chart using simple CSS/JS bars. Use Tailwind CDN, Google Fonts, project color palette.

Create admin/alumnos.php - Full CRUD: list all students with search by name/matricula, inline form or modal to create new student (matricula, nombre, apellido_paterno, apellido_materno), edit existing student, delete with confirmation, show current status (en plantel/fuera based on last asistencia record). Pagination for large lists. Table columns: matricula, nombre completo, estado actual, acciones.

Create admin/tutores.php - Full CRUD: list tutors with linked student info (JOIN on matricula_alumno), create new tutor (matricula_alumno, nombre_tutor, telefono, password_tutor), edit tutor, delete with confirmation, show vinculaciones (which student each tutor is linked to). Search by name or student matricula.

Create admin/asistencias.php - Attendance history: filterable table (by date range, by student matricula/name, by tipo Entrada/Salida), search functionality, pagination (20 per page), summary statistics at top (total records, entradas today, salidas today). Table columns: fecha, hora, alumno (nombre), matricula, tipo, registrado_en.

Create admin/usuarios.php - System users CRUD for the 'usuarios' table: list all users, create user (username, password_admin, nombre_completo, rol), edit user, delete with confirmation (prevent self-delete). Roles: Admin, Prefecto, Vigilante. Show ultimo_acceso. Password field for create/edit.

Create admin/dispositivos.php - FCM tokens viewer: list all registered devices from dispositivos_padres table (id, matricula_alumno, token_fcm preview, fecha_registro), show which student each device is linked to (JOIN alumnos), button to send test notification using enviar_notificacion.php pattern, delete token option.

All 6 files must share a consistent sidebar component (can be inline PHP include pattern), consistent header, consistent footer. Use the same CSS custom classes (.bg-crema, .text-vino, .bg-vino, .text-dorado, .font-serif-elegant, .font-sans-clean). Desktop-first layout with responsive mobile support (collapsible sidebar). Each file handles its own AJAX/form POST actions for CRUD operations.
acceptance_criteria: All 6 PHP files exist in admin/ directory and pass php -l syntax check
Each file checks $_SESSION['usuario_autenticado'] and redirects to ../login_admin.php if not set
Each file includes require_once '../conexion.php' for database access
Each file has a sidebar with navigation links to all 6 admin pages
Each file uses Tailwind CSS via CDN and the project color palette (crema, vino, dorado)
Each file uses Google Fonts (Playfair Display + Plus Jakarta Sans)
index.php shows real-time stats from the database (entradas/salidas del dia, alumnos en plantel)
alumnos.php implements full CRUD (list, create, edit, delete) with search
tutores.php implements full CRUD with student linkage display
asistencias.php shows filterable paginated attendance history
usuarios.php implements full CRUD for system users with roles
dispositivos.php lists FCM tokens with send test notification capability
All database queries use PDO prepared statements via the $pdo variable from conexion.php
Responsive design works on both desktop and mobile (collapsible sidebar)
verification: Run: for f in /projects/sandbox/SGA-COBAEV/admin/*.php; do php -l "$f"; done - all files must show 'No syntax errors detected'
Verify each file contains 'session_start()' and auth check for $_SESSION['usuario_autenticado']
Verify sidebar navigation exists in each file with links to all 6 pages
findings: All 6 PHP files created and pass php -l syntax check. Post-review fixes applied: (1) tutor/user password inputs changed to type=password, (2) CSRF token protection added to all POST forms, (3) LIMIT/OFFSET interpolation secured with explicit intval() casts, (4) usuarios.php restricted to Admin role only, (5) N+1 query in alumnos.php replaced with single JOIN query, (6) match() replaced with switch/case for PHP 7.x compatibility. No password hashing added (intentional plaintext for XAMPP dev). database_structure.sql not modified. Additional: Avisos notification system added (admin/avisos.php, api/obtener_avisos.php, api/marcar_leido.php) with bell notification in padres.php header and sidebar link in admin/index.php.
